description: Startup, `--version`, and `/session-info` show **Grok Local** and **Grok Build** versions together.
`grok-local update` installs our GitHub releases; `grok-local update --upstream` overlay-merges xai-org/grok-build without replacing LM Studio, SearxNG, or `~/.grok-local`.
Welcome changelog lists Grok Local notes first, then the current Grok Build notes.
